title: Turn right
description:
A robot faces one of four directions. Using the enum that is already defined, write:

- `Direction turnRight(Direction d)`: north becomes east, east becomes south, south becomes west, west becomes north.
- `std::string_view name(Direction d)`: returns `"north"`, `"east"`, `"south"` or `"west"`.

Use a `switch` in each.
